## Core Technical Skills & Expertise

### Frontend & Web Technologies
- **Core Languages**: JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: React.js, Next.js (App Router & SSR/SSG), Vite
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit, React Context API, TanStack Query (React Query), Zustand
- **Styling & Design Systems**: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Styled Components, Modern Vanilla CSS, Glassmorphism, Micro-Animations
- **Performance & Optimization**: Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), Bundle Optimization, Code Splitting, Lazy Loading, Lighthouse Auditing
- **Backend & APIs**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row Level Security, Auth), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSocket integrations
- **Version Control & CI/CD**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Netlify, PWA (Progressive Web Apps)

## Key Production Projects

### 1. Kiska Kitna Hisab — Expense Splitter & 1-Click UPI Settlement
- **URL**: https://kiskakitnahisab.netlify.app/
- **Category**: FinTech / Consumer Product
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase (PostgreSQL Database & Auth with Row Level Security), Tailwind CSS
- **Key Capabilities**: 
  - Full-stack Splitwise-inspired group expense manager.
  - Greedy debt minimization algorithm reducing N-way settlement transactions.
  - Instant UPI payment deep-link and dynamic QR code generation for 1-click settlement via Google Pay, PhonePe, and Paytm.
  - Granular split calculations: equal, exact amounts, and percentage splits.

### 2. Shopperce AI — Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Platform
- **URL**: https://shopperce.ai/
- **Category**: Enterprise Commerce Architecture
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs
- **Key Capabilities**: 
  - Dynamic multi-tenant theme injection and custom routing logic.
  - Configurable partner storefronts rendered dynamically from unified frontend codebase.
  - Comprehensive seller admin dashboards for catalog, order lifecycle, customer, and revenue analytics.

### 3. LiveLaw — India's Premier Legal Journalism Platform
- **URL**: https://www.livelaw.in/
- **Category**: High-Traffic Media & Journalism
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Key Capabilities**: 
  - High-speed article reader components and live court hearing tickers.
  - Sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) for 1M+ active monthly readers.
  - SEO structured data integration boosting search visibility for legal jurisprudence reporting.

### 4. NextLeap IT Solutions — Corporate Enterprise Platform
- **URL**: https://nextleapitsolutions.netlify.app/
- **Category**: Enterprise Corporate Services
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Key Capabilities**: 
  - Scalable, modular enterprise presentation architecture.
  - 30% Time-to-First-Byte (TTFB) reduction through client-side asset optimization and lazy hydration.
  - Accessible, responsive UI components designed with Figma precision.
